values.meaning: cooldown reduction on landing the wall stun
values.binNote: Wiki states a 35% cooldown reduction on hit; the bin's SkarnerE.RefundPercent is 0.65, not 0.35 - possibly a refund-of-remaining-cooldown value (65% refunded) rather than a flat 35% reduction, or the wiki text is inverted/outdated relative to the bin.

mechanics.claim: Colliding with an enemy champion or large monster grabs, attaches, and suppresses them, revealing them, for the remainder of the charge.
mechanics.quote: he grabs them with his claws for the time of the remaining charge, {{tip|attach|attaching}} them to himself, {{tip|suppression|suppressing}} them, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them

mechanics.claim: Damage and stun only occur if the attached target collides with terrain, ending the charge.
mechanics.quote: If '''Skarner's''' attached target collides with terrain, the charge ends, detaching them from him, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|1.1}} seconds

mechanics.claim: If the target resists the suppression (CC immunity, displacement immunity, or spell shield), Skarner does not attach them and the charge ends instantly without damage.
mechanics.quote: If the target resists the suppression through {{tip|cc-immune|total crowd control immunity}}, {{tip|displacement immune|displacement immunity}}, or a {{tip|spell shield}}. '''Skarner''' will not attach them to himself, causing the charge to end instantly.

mechanics.claim: If the target removes the suppression by cleanse or dispel, they detach immediately, ending the charge and not applying damage.
mechanics.quote: If the target removes the suppression by any means, including with an applicable {{tip|cleanse}} effect or {{tip|dispel}}, they will detach themselves from '''Skarner''' immediately which forces the charge to end instantly and not apply any damage.

mechanics.claim: Ixtal's Impact's cooldown begins after the effect ends, not on cast.
